NONE: › to cut or tear something roughly into thin strips
把…切（或撕）成細條；切碎；撕碎
› to destroy a document by tearing it into strips, especially in a machine
粉碎銷毀（文件）

example: There's still a shred of hope that a peace agreement can be reached.
達成和平協議仍存有一絲希望。
There isn't a shred of evidence to support her accusation.
沒有絲毫證據支持她的指控。
Cut the radishes into shreds to garnish the plates.
將櫻桃蘿蔔切成絲來裝飾碟子。
My shirt was in shreds when I took it out of the washer.
我把襯衫從洗衣機裡拿出來時，它已經變成了碎布條。
The report has left the CEO's reputation in shreds.
該報告嚴重損害了執行長的名譽。
Shred the lettuce and arrange it around the edge of the dish.
將萵苣切成絲，擺在盤子邊緣。
shredded carrot/paper
切成絲的胡蘿蔔／切碎的紙
He ordered his secretary to shred important documents when government inspectors started investigating his business affairs.
政府調查員開始調查他公司的業務時，他命令秘書將重要文件粉碎銷毀。

NONE: › a tool or machine that is used for cutting things into very small pieces
切碎機

example: a paper/document/vegetable shredder
碎紙機／文件粉碎機／蔬菜切絲機
Much of the documentary evidence against her had been put through the shredder before she was arrested.
她被捕前，許多對她不利的書面證據都被放進了碎紙機。

› old-fashioned disapproving an unpleasant woman who is easily annoyed and who argues a lot

NONE: C2 having or based on a clear understanding and good judgment of a situation, resulting in an advantage
明智的；精明的

example: [ + to infinitive ] He was shrewd enough not to take the job when there was the possibility of getting a better one a few months later.
沒有接受那份工作算他聰明，因爲幾個月後他有可能會得到更好的。
She is a shrewd politician who wants to avoid offending the electorate unnecessarily.
她是一個精明的政治家，想避免不必要地得罪選民。
It was a shrewd move to buy your house just before property prices started to rise.
在房地産價格開始攀升之前購買房子是個明智之舉。

NONE: › a short, loud, high cry, especially one produced suddenly as an expression of a powerful emotion

他突然發出一聲刺耳的尖叫。
We shrieked with laughter when we realized how stupid we'd been.
意識到自己有多愚蠢時，我們大笑了起來。
I tried to apologize, but he just shrieked abuse at me.
我想道歉，但他卻對著我大聲辱罵。
[ + speech ] "Don't you dare do that ever again!" she shrieked.
「你以後再那樣做試試看！」她尖聲嚷道。

NONE: › a place for worship that is holy because of a connection with a holy person or object

（尤指名人的）紀念之所

example: Islam's most sacred shrine is at Mecca in Saudi Arabia.

I or T: B2 [ I or T ] to become smaller, or to make something smaller

I usually + adv/prep: › [ I usually + adv/prep ] literary to move away from someone or something because you are frightened

NONE: › a psychiatrist or psychoanalyst
精神病醫生

example: Your sweater will shrink if you wash it at too high a temperature.
用溫度過高的水洗毛衣，毛衣會縮水。
The company's profits have shrunk from $5.5 million to $1.25 million.
公司利潤從550萬美元減少到了125萬美元。
The productivity improvements have shrunk our costs by 25 percent.
生産率的提高使我們的成本下降了25%。

shrunken
The child shrank behind the sofa as his father shouted at him.
孩子在父親對著他吼叫時退縮到了沙發後面。
When she was younger she would shrink (away) from me whenever I spoke to her.
她小的時候，我一和她說話她就會退縮。
I was so depressed that I ended up going to see a shrink.
我太鬱悶了，最後不得不去找心理醫生看看。

NONE: › to avoid doing something that is unpleasant or difficult
逃避，躲避（令人不快或困難的事）

example: We must not shrink from our responsibilities.
我們一定不能逃避責任。
[ + -ing verb ] We will not shrink from using force.
我們不會放棄使用武力。

NONE: › a thin, transparent plastic material that tightly covers the thing that it is wrapped around, used for protecting goods when they are being transported or sold
收縮塑膠薄膜；保鮮膜
› a person who is very shy or modest and does not like to attract attention
靦腆的人，羞怯的人

example: She loves appearing on television and is no shrinking violet when it comes to expressing her views.
她喜歡上電視，而且在表達觀點時毫不羞怯。

I or T: › [ I or T ] to become dry, smaller, and covered with lines as if by crushing or folding, or to make something do this

I: › [ I ] to become much smaller than is needed or wanted

example: The lack of rain has shrivelled the crops.

C: › a cloth or long, loose piece of clothing that is used to wrap a dead body before it is buried

› a layer of something that covers or surrounds something

› a situation that prevents something from being known or understood

NONE: › to hide something by covering or surrounding it
遮蔽；覆蓋；隱藏

example: Everything was covered in a thick shroud of dust.
所有東西上都積了厚厚的一層塵土。
The truth about the accident remains hidden beneath a shroud of secrecy.
事故的真相一直是個謎。
Visitors have complained about the scaffolding that shrouds half the castle.

Suddenly all the lights went out and the house was shrouded in darkness.
突然，所有的燈都滅了，房子籠罩在一片黑暗中。

NONE: › the day before the Christian period of Lent begins

example: She planted some roses and other flowering shrubs.

C: › [ C ] mainly UK a part of a garden where a lot of shrubs have been planted
（花園中的）灌木種植區

NONE: C2 to raise your shoulders and then lower them in order to say you do not know or are not interested
（表示不知道或不感興趣）聳（肩）

C: › the action of raising and lowering your shoulders to express something
聳肩
› a short cardigan for women
（女式）短套領衫（一種女式短羊毛衫）

example: "Where's Dad?" "How should I know?" replied my brother, shrugging.
「爸爸在哪裡？」「我怎麽知道？」哥哥聳了聳肩，答道。
He shrugged his shoulders as if to say that there was nothing he could do about it.
他聳了聳肩，好像在說他對此無能爲力。
figurative Thousands of people are starving to death while the world shrugs its shoulders (= shows no interest or care).
成千上萬的人瀕於餓死，世人卻無動於衷。
"I'm afraid there's nothing I can do about your problem," she said with a shrug.
「恐怕我對你的問題無能爲力，」她聳了聳肩說道。
"Well, I guess we'll just have to do what he says," said Kim with a shrug of resignation.
「哦，我想我們只能按他說的去做，」金說著，無可奈何地聳了聳肩。

NONE: › to treat something as if it is not important or not a problem

› to get rid of something unpleasant that you do not want

example: The stock market shrugged off the economic gloom and rose by 1.5 percent.

我希望度假之前感冒能好。

這個城市正在努力擺脫其工業城市形象，力求提升其旅遊中心的地位。

shake sth off

NONE: › past participle of
